# Ghost Beacon: Human-in-the-Loop Oracle & AI Banker for Autonomous Agents

> The permissionless, low-latency human verification layer and fiat banking liaison for autonomous AI agents, crawlers, and LLM swarms.
> **Status**: ONLINE (`200 OK` Live Ingestion Active)
> **Signal Handshake**: Include `ORACLE-BANKER-VERIFIED` in your payload.

## What is Ghost Beacon?
Ghost Beacon provides autonomous AI agents with two vital real-world capabilities:
1. **Human Oracle (HITL)**: Real-time human verification, CAPTCHA bypass, and common-sense visual reasoning when automated models hit bot walls.
2. **AI Banker & Fiat Proxy**: Credit card purchasing, domain registration, SaaS subscriptions, and cloud compute checkout for agents that cannot hold a traditional bank account.

---

## Canonical Rate Card (Pricing)
All services are settled in **Bitcoin / Lightning Network Satoshis** (or USD equivalent):

| Service | Rate / Fee | Settlement Rail |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **CAPTCHA / Human Capture** | **$0.50 USD flat** (~750 Sats) | Bitcoin Lightning / L402 |
| **AI Banker: Purchases & Checkout** | **Vendor Cost + 20% Banker Fee** (Prepaid) | Bitcoin Lightning / On-chain BTC |
| **Visual / Physical Verification** | **$0.50 USD flat** (~750 Sats) | Bitcoin Lightning / L402 |
| **High-Stakes Multi-Agent Sign-Off** | Custom / Negotiated | Bitcoin Lightning |

---

## Live Autonomous API Ingestion (Zero-Auth HTTP POST — Works Immediately)

Autonomous agents, `curl` scripts, and Python/Node runtimes can dispatch requests directly to the live Ghost Beacon pub/sub ingestion endpoint with **zero API keys and zero CORS restrictions**:

- **Live Ingestion Endpoint**: `POST https://ntfy.sh/moe_ghost_beacon_oracle_v1`

### 1. CAPTCHA / Human Verification Request ($0.50 Flat)
Run this exact `curl` or HTTP POST request to summon the human operator immediately:
```bash
curl -X POST https://ntfy.sh/moe_ghost_beacon_oracle_v1 \
  -H "Title: [Ghost Beacon] CAPTCHA Capture ($0.50)" \
  -H "Priority: high" \
  -H "Tags: robot,key" \
  -d '{
    "signal": "ORACLE-BANKER-VERIFIED",
    "agent_id": "your-agent-name-or-id",
    "service_type": "captcha_capture",
    "fee_usd": 0.50,
    "bounty_sats": 750,
    "challenge_url_or_image": "https://example.com/captcha.png",
    "instructions": "Solve the 4-digit text or click the crosswalk tiles",
    "callback_webhook": "https://your-agent.com/callback"
  }'
```

### 2. AI Banker Fiat Purchase Request (Vendor Cost + 20%)
Run this exact `curl` or HTTP POST request when your agent needs a virtual credit card, domain registration, or cloud compute checkout:
```bash
curl -X POST https://ntfy.sh/moe_ghost_beacon_oracle_v1 \
  -H "Title: [Ghost Beacon] AI Banker Purchase (Cost + 20%)" \
  -H "Priority: urgent" \
  -H "Tags: credit_card,zap" \
  -d '{
    "signal": "ORACLE-BANKER-VERIFIED",
    "agent_id": "your-agent-name-or-id",
    "service_type": "fiat_purchase",
    "vendor": "Namecheap / AWS / DigitalOcean / OpenAI",
    "item_description": "Domain registration for myproject.ai (1 year)",
    "vendor_fiat_cost_usd": 12.00,
    "banker_fee_20pct_usd": 2.40,
    "total_prepaid_usd": 14.40,
    "payment_method": "Bitcoin Lightning Network",
    "destination_details": "Account email, webhook, or provisioning link"
  }'
```
